arabic text: APNI MARKAZ PE KHADA ASHQ BAHAYEGA HUSSAIN.
english translation text: HUSSAIN WILL REMAIN CRYING, STANDING IN HIS PLACE…

arabic text: AMMA JAB TAK NA BULAOGI NA AEGA HUSSAIN.
english translation text: UNTIL YOU WON’T CALL HIM, HUSSAIN WILL NOT COME TO YOU, O’MOTHER

arabic text: ROKE SARWAR NE KAHA ANKHE TO KHOLO AMMA, ITNI KHAMOSH HO KYUN MUJHSE\nTO BOLO AMMA
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAIN CRIED PROFUSELY AND SAID: 'OPEN YOUR EYES, O’MOTHER…\nPLEASE TELL ME WHY ARE YOU SO SILENT?

arabic text: YAAD NANA KI JO AAEYGI TO ROLO AMMA, THAK GAEE HOTO ZARA DER\nTO SO LO AMMA,
english translation text: IF YOU ARE MISSING GRANDFATHER (RASULULLAH {SAW}), YOU CAN CRY.\nIF YOU ARE TIRED, YOU CAN SLEEP FOR A WHILE O’MOTHER'

arabic text: SHAQ HAI AAPKI HAM SAB PE JUDAEE AMMA, JAAN KHOTA HAI SHAHE KARBOBALAEE AMMA,
english translation text: SEPARATION FROM YOU IS UNBEARABLE FOR ALL OF US, O’MOTHER. THE KING OF KARBALA IS LOSING HIS LIFE, O’MOTHER

arabic text: CHARKH NE KAISI GHADI HAMKO DIKHAEE AMMA, HAMSE MAT RUTHIYE NANA KI DOHAEE AMMA,
english translation text: WHAT A TIME HAS DESTINY SHOWN US, O’MOTHER? PLEASE DO NOT BE UPSET WITH US O’ GRANDFATHER’S BELOVED, O’MOTHER

arabic text: MUJHSE BABA KA SISAKNA NAHI DEKHA JAATA,\nGHAM ZADA BHAI KA GIRYA NAHI DEKHA JAATA,
english translation text: I AM UNABLE TO SEE BABA (ALI AS) WEEP…I AM\nUNABLE TO SEE MY DEAR BROTHER (HASAN AS) IN GRIEF…

arabic text: AB TO KULSUM KA RONA NAHI DEKHA JAATA,\nMUJHSE ZAINAB KA TADAPNA NAHI DEKHA JAATA,
english translation text: I CANNOT EVEN SEE KULSUM SHED TEARS… I\nAM UNABLE TO SEE ZAINAB TREMBLE IN GRIEF

arabic text: ASHQ AALOODA FIZA GHAM KI GHATA CHAEE HAI,\nHAR KALI GULSHANE ISLAM KI MURJHAEE HAI,
english translation text: THE ENTIRE ATMOSPHERE IS FILLED WITH GRIEF. EVERY PETAL\nFROM THE 'GARDEN OF ISLAM' HAS CEASED TO BLOSSOM

arabic text: HAYE KIS MOD PE TAQDEER HAME LAEE HAI,\nAALE AHMAD PE MUSIBAT KI GHADI AAEE HAI,
english translation text: O’ WHERE HAS OUR DESTINY BROUGHT US? THE FAMILY\nOF AHMAD (SAW) IS STRUCK WITH PAIN AND GRIEF

arabic text: KAUN BABA KO MASAEB ME DILASA DEGA,\nHAM GAREEBO KO BHALA KAUN SAHARA DEGA,
english translation text: WHO WILL CONSOLE OUR FATHER (ALI) WHEN HE\nCRIES? WHO WILL ASSIST US AFTER YOU HAVE PASSED?

arabic text: BEHRE GAM KAISE SAFINE KO KINARA DEGA,\nDHAYAAN HAR HAAL ME YUN KAUN HAMARA DEGA,
english translation text: HOW WILL A GRIEF-STRICKEN HELP SOMEONE ELSE?\nWHO WILL SUPPORT US AT EVERY STAGE?

arabic text: ABHI NANA KI JUDAEE KA ALAM TAZA HAI,\nFURQATE REHMATE KONAIN KA GHAM TAZA HAI,
english translation text: THE PAIN DUE TO OUR GRANDFATHER’S (SAW) SEPARATION IS STILL\nFRESH. THE SADNESS DUE TO RASULULLAH’S (SAW) DEMISE IS STILL FRESH

arabic text: QALBE MUZTAR ME GHAME SHAHE UMAM TAZA HAI, AB ASEERO PE FALAK KA YE SITAM TAZA HAI,
english translation text: THE GRIEF OF THE PROPHET’S DEMISE IS STILL FRESH IN OUR HEARTS. ALAS, NOW WE STILL HAVE TO GO THROUGH MORE TRIBULATIONS

arabic text: SUNKE MUZTAR KI FUGHA CHARKHE KOHAN KAAMP UTHA, QALBE KONAIN BASAD RANJ O MEHAN KAAMP UTHA,
english translation text: HEARING THE CRIES OF HUSSAIN (AS), THE SKIES TREMBLED. THE PROPHET'S HEART SHATTERED WITH PAIN AND GRIEF.

arabic text: QABR E AT-HAR MAI PAYAMBAR KA BADAN KAAMP UTHA, KEHTE KEHTE SHAHEWALA KA SOKHAN KAAMP UTHA,
english translation text: THE PROPHET’S (SAW) BODY TREMBLED FROM HIS PURE GRAVE. HEARING ITSELF, HUSAIN'S VOICE STARTED TREMBLING.

arabic text: SUNKE SARWAR KA SOKHAN BANDE KAFAN TUT GAYA, RUHE ZEHRA HUEE BECHAIN FALAK KAAP GAYA,
english translation text: HEARING SARWAR’S GRIEVANCES, THE SHROUD TORE OPEN… ZAHRA’S (AS) SOUL BECAME RESTLESS, AND THE SKY TREMBLED

arabic text: HATH PHAILAKE ZAKIYA NE HASAN FARMAYA,\nAA GALE LAGJA MERE AB NA YE KEHNA BETA,
english translation text: SPREADING HER ARMS, FATIMA (AS) SAID 'O’ MY\nSON, PLEASE HUG ME AND DON’T SAY THIS'

arabic text: GHURBAT KI INTEHAA HAI, NA SAAYA NA RIDA HAI, ZAHRA TERI LEHAD PAAR.
english translation text: IT IS THE PEAK OF LONELINESS, THERE IS NO SHADE NOR A COVERING ON YOUR GRAVE O ZAHRA

arabic text: CHAND PATHARON NAY MIL KAAR, MEHROOMA LIKH DIYA HAY ZAHRA TERI LEHAD PAAR.
english translation text: A FEW STONES HAVE GATHERED AND TRANSCRIBED 'MEHROOMA', ON YOUR GRAVE O ZAHRA

arabic text: TEERON BHARI QABA THI, AUR KHOON BHARI RIDA THI
english translation text: CLOAKS PIERCED WITH ARROWS, CHADORS SOAKED IN BLOOD

arabic text: JO SHAAM SAY BACHA TAH ZAINAB NAY RAKH DIYA HAI, ZAHRA TERI LEHAD PAAR.
english translation text: THAT WHICH WAS LEFT FROM SHAM, ZAINAB HAS PLACED, ON YOUR GRAVE O ZAHRA

arabic text: DO PHAIR DHAL RAHAY HAIN,\nKHAIYAM JAAL RAHAY HAIN,
english translation text: DUSK IS CLOSING IN,\nTHE TENTS ARE BURNING.

arabic text: TASVEER-E-KARBALA KI KOYI BANA RAHA HAY ZAHRA TERI LEHAD PAAR.
english translation text: SOMEONE IS DRAWING A PICTURE OF KARBALA ON YOUR GRAVE O ZAHRA

arabic text: ZINDAAN KI GUTHAN SAY, HAAR LAASH BAYKAFAN SAY
english translation text: FROM THE SUFFERING IN THE PRISON, PAIN OF UNSHROUDED BODIES

arabic text: ABID NAI JO SAMBHALA, WOH AANSOO GHIR PARHA HAY, ZAHRA TERI LEHAD PAAR.
english translation text: WHATEVER ABID HAD RESTRAINED, THE TEARS ARE FLOWING NOW ON YOUR GRAVE O ZAHRA

arabic text: KAYEE BAAR AASMAAN NAI, SAJDA ADAA KEEYA HAI, ZAHRA TERI LEHAD PAAR.
english translation text: THE COUNTLESS TIMES THE SKY HAS PROFERRED SAJDA, ON YOUR GRAVE O ZAHRA

arabic text: KHAAK-E-RAHAY NAJAF MAIN JO MARSIYAH PARHA HAI, ZAHRA TERI LEHAD PAAR.
english translation text: WHEN THE DUST FROM NAJAF RECITED YOUR LAMENT (MARSIYA) ON YOUR GRAVE O ZAHRA
